description: Highways Capital Programme is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. Bolton Council is responsible for a number of transport improvement schemes across the Borough. The highway capital programme includes roads, footways and bridges maintenance schemes and transport and environmental improvements. The searchable list of Highway Capital Programme has been developed in compliance with the requirement laid out by the CON29 enquiries. Coverage: Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council. The portal shows 2016-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
